Msg_ServerGuide1: This feature allows you to create a local hotspot server. The server is responsible for displaying translated text retrieved from the Localay app. You can access the server from any device within the LAN network.
Msg_ServerGuide2: This feature allows you to use your phone as a screen to view translations, which is useful for people who do not use multiple monitors.
Msg_CreateProfileGuide: To create a new profile, enter the profile name in the 'Profile Name' field and click the 'Create Profile' button.
Msg_ProfileNameNote: Important: Profile name must be unaccented characters and no spaces, for example: GodOfWar, GTAV, TheLastOfUs, etc
Msg_RemoveProfileGuide: To remove a new profile, select the profile name in the combobox 'Select Profile' and click the 'Remove Profile' button.
Msg_UpdateProfileGuide: To update a new profile, select the profile name in the combobox 'Select Profile' and click the 'Update Profile' button. This will update all current configs in settings to the profile you choose.
Msg_LoadProfileGuide: To load a new profile, select the profile name in the combobox 'Select Profile' and click the 'Load Profile' button. This will apply all configurations from the selected profile to your current settings.
Tip_ExcludeCharName: The application will automatically exclude character's name in the dialogue. The required format is <character name>: <dialogue>
Msg_RoboticVoicesGuide: To install robotic language voices, go to Settings > Time & language > Speech > Add voices. Select the language you want, click the Add button then wait for the voice to be added to the system. After that, reset the RstGameTranslation application to display the new voices.
Msg_NaturalVoicesStep3: 3. Natural voices will appear in the combo box above marked with (SAPI), while robotic voices will be marked with (UWP).
Msg_NaturalVoicesStep4: 4. For voice languages not available in the list, please select the Multilingual voices in the combo box. These voices can speak multiple languages in addition to their main language.

AudioCapture_ExcludeSelf: All system audio except this app (recommended)
AudioCapture_Device: Default output device (includes this app's TTS)
Tip_AudioCaptureMode: Excluding this app keeps its own TTS voice out of speech recognition. Needs Windows 10 version 2004 or later; otherwise the default device is used and capture pauses while TTS is speaking. Applies the next time audio translation starts.
Tip_VadMode: Silero tells speech apart from music and sound effects. The volume threshold setting only applies to RMS mode. Applies the next time audio translation starts.
Tip_SileroThreshold: Speech probability threshold, 0.05-0.95 (default 0.5). Lower picks up quieter speech; higher ignores more background noise.
Tip_WhisperReducedContext: Whisper processes lines up to 10 seconds with a smaller window, about 2-5x faster. Turn off if lines end with wrong or invented words.
Tip_TtsAutoSpeedUp: When translated lines arrive faster than they can be read, read the next ones faster (up to 1.5x) to catch up with the game.
Tip_GoogleFreeFallback: The free Google Translate service can be rate limited (HTTP 429). Meanwhile, lines are translated with this service instead. Only applies to the free web service.

Tip_Temperature: Controls randomness: lower = more deterministic, higher = more creative (0.0 - 2.0)
Tip_TopK: Limits the next token selection to the K most likely tokens (1 - 100)
Tip_AutoOcr: Auto OCR realtime, turn off this feature the program will not auto translate
Tip_MangaMode: When enabled, text is grouped by speech bubble (vertical columns for Japanese, horizontal lines otherwise) and each bubble is translated separately, all in one request.
Tip_MultiSelection: Enable multi selection area for text selection.
Tip_OverlayColors: Adjust overlay background and text colour
Tip_AutoOverlayBackground: Smart select background color for overlay base on image
Tip_OcrSignal: Show small icon when starting OCR and translate
Tip_MergeText: Automatically merge text blocks that would overlap when translation is longer than original text
Tip_LeaveOnscreen: Always show the translation on the Monitor window and don't bother showing the source language, makes it easier to read translations while new ones are being made
Tip_BlockPower: If higher, text is more likely to be glued together to make a large paragraph. Lower does the opposite, good for say, tiny buttons or menu options. Also affects character-level grouping.
Tip_LineSpacing: Factor for normal line spacing. Default 0.63. Larger = lines merge more easily.
Tip_SettleTime: Time in seconds to wait for the text to settle before capturing
Tip_TextSimilarity:
Check the similarity between two consecutive texts. 
For example, 0.5 is equivalent to 50% - if text 1 has a similarity greater than or equal to 50%, it will be skipped.
Tip_MinFragment: Minimum number of characters for a text fragment to be processed. Smaller fragments will be ignored.
Tip_LetterConfidence: Minimum confidence threshold for individual letters/characters (0.0-1.0). Characters with confidence below this threshold will be filtered out.
Tip_LineConfidence: Minimum confidence threshold for text lines (0.0-1.0). Lines with average confidence below this threshold will be filtered out.
Tip_Hdr: This feature will use HDR support for the results before sending them to other OCRs. This feature will improve performance but will reduce accuracy in some cases
Tip_MaxContext: Maximum number of previous text pieces to include as context. Set to 0 to disable context.
Tip_MinContext: Minimum size in characters for a text piece to be included as context. Helps avoid adding tiny menu labels or buttons as context.
Tip_MinChatText: Minimum size in characters for text to be shown in ChatBox. Smaller text will be ignored.
Tip_GameInfo: Information about the game being played to help the LLM translate more accurately.
Tip_ClearContext: Clear all translation history and context. Forces new translation on next capture.
